propositions: The inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py) has zero production callers after bug 3b5f-1b21-ee14-4bdf removed the producer, dispatch arm, and router.
The port's original purpose (same-pass issue re-creation) is prohibited by an earlier operator ruling on bug 3b5f, making the capability unmotivated and safe to delete.
Re-homing the port to binding_walk was rejected because it would violate ADR 0028 ownership boundaries, use incompatible vocabularies, and resurrect a feature already ruled out.
The deletion is a pure code removal with no behavioral change: the live outbound probe and deletion detection remain untouched and continue to function.

The orphaned resolved_statuses configuration keys (jira.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses) are deferred to a follow-up ticket since removing documented config requires a separate user-visible deprecation decision.
